summary: Panetta's lifetime USCPR score of F reflects consistent pro-Israel voting: yes on $14 billion in weapons, codifying the IHRA definition, banning PLO members from the U.S., sanctioning the ICC, and revoking tax status from pro-Palestine organizations. His 2025 letter to the Israeli ambassador backed Israel's military campaign in Gaza, and he has not sponsored Block the Bombs, UNRWA restoration, or Nakba recognition.
